subject.title: fix(ui): long chats retain generated image memory

question: Does current-head Chromium evidence show that the post-proof deferred-preview changes still preserve popup-safe opening while evicted managed images refetch and render correctly?
rationale: The patch has substantive earlier browser proof, but the final head changed the click/open safety path after that run; static review cannot establish the browser activation behavior conclusively.
